prompts.island:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one large TRANSPARENT campaign-map island land plate for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE. Input image 1 is STYLE reference: retain the exact densely detailed crisp 16-bit isometric miniature pixel art, dark outlines, layered coastal rock, hard pixel clusters and illustrated arcade campaign-map scale. Input image 2 is PLACEMENT reference ONLY: this new island will sit in the open water WEST/left of the green coast, BELOW the bridge, and north of the separate southern islands. Do not reproduce that entire map. Generate ONLY the new isolated island, full silhouette visible with generous alpha padding.
Primary request: a GIANT coastal island of death and decay, devastated by a giant ALIEN COMET that crashed into it and is spreading its madness. Approximately square landplate, substantial low coastal land, irregular bays and shores with a narrow dark turquoise/white surf fringe, genuine alpha beyond. Centerpiece MUST unmistakably be a HUGE elongated jagged alien comet half buried diagonally in a vast impact crater: black obsidian and scorched iron crust, fractured purple-violet luminous crystal core, massive boulder shape rather than a temple/tower/volcano, impact gouge running toward one shoreline, smashed crater rings and radiating cracked earth. Alien black-purple tendrils, violet energy veins and diseased biomass radiate out from the comet across the island into ruined roads and coast. The comet is the largest focal feature and readable from campaign-map distance.
Surround it with dead gray-brown palms and twisted skeletal trees, ash-black scorched grass, collapsed concrete ruins of former coastal settlements, broken seawalls and wrecked small docks, gray sand beaches, a couple sickly teal tidal pools and cracked barren plateaus. Tiny remnants of dying green vegetation farthest from impact emphasize decay. A few small splinter rocks in the surf attached to silhouette, no distant detached islands. Dark unsettling biome with selective violet and turquoise lights, strong readable edges, not a flat black mass. One small clear empty ledge near the south coast is reserved for a later separate hovering level icon, but DO NOT draw any icon or flag yet. Keep clouds/smoke, drones and boats OUT of this image; they will be independent map objects. No ocean background rectangle, no horizon, no text, numbers, labels, route lines, UI, people or gore. Match reference pixel density and camera.
prompts.surround:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet of SIX separate ambience/surrounding objects for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE's comet-corrupted coastal campaign map. Input reference is for exact rich 16-bit pixel art, overhead-isometric miniature material palette and dark outline style. Strict THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, six equal isolated cells, 15% transparent margin in each cell and wide gutters, every silhouette fully inside cell. Genuine alpha 0 background, no black rectangle, no painted glow backdrop, no text/labels/grid/flags/UI.
TOP ROW, left to right: (1) long layered charcoal and muted purple storm cloud bank with cool silver top-edge pixel highlights and a dim violet internal fissure, no external lightning; (2) broad pale-gray coastal cloud with a dirty lilac ash underside, clean stepped pixel edges; (3) separated curling ash-and-spore cloud, dark gray/violet, a few tiny cyan particles close inside its silhouette, no column stretching to ground. These three are aerial map overlays, different recognizable silhouettes, no hard cast shadows or soft blurred halo.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right: (4) small jagged comet-shard REEF, three black obsidian splinters protruding from a tiny gray rock base, glowing violet cracks and only narrow turquoise/white surf fringe; (5) derelict half-submerged rusted cargo ship hull viewed high overhead/isometric, broken deck with alien black-violet growth, tiny white foam around hull, no crew; (6) tiny dead palm islet, cracked gray sand and 3 skeletal palms consumed by purple tendrils, low rough stone edges, tiny attached surf. These are isolated surface map decorations to place independently AROUND a larger island. Never connect them to one another; no surrounding ocean plane. Crisp hard pixel clusters, restrained small palette and original game sprite art.
